card.name: Space before numbers in injection instructions
card.fires_on: Mostly the blank space just before a number (dose, volume, interval, temperature) in injectable-drug instructions. Also fires on small words or on 'injection' itself in injection-related text.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The whitespace token right before a figure for interval, dose, volume or temperature in injection text.

modes.label: Word 'injection' or linking word
modes.description: The word injection, or a small word like 'into' or 'the', in the middle of injection directions.
modes.example: injection sites within the same region from one<< injection>> to the next to reduce risk of lip

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing the word injection or inject next.
card.plain: It lights up in injection instructions, at spots where a number or the word injection is about to come up.
